review.why: Writes SDR, account executive, account management, sales engineering and sales leadership resumes with correct quota math.
review.summary: Asks for role, segment, territory and sales motion, then gives evidence prompts per role. It keeps bookings, recognized revenue, recurring revenue, contract value and pipeline distinct, states the period and denominator for attainment and win rates, and shows the user's part in shared deals. The example contrasts 120% of quota with exceeding quota by 120%.
strengths: Never annualizes a partial year or implies steady overperformance from one quarter
Confidential amounts can be replaced by approved ratios or ranges
No invented logos, references or awards
cautions: Instructions only: no templates or scripts
Post-sale adoption and retention work is left to another skill
